description: This file defines the interface for a test controller within the WPEFramework, including nested interfaces for tests and categories, along with methods for managing and executing tests.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController
classes.description: Main interface for controlling and querying test categories and tests.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::ITest
classes.description: Interface representing an individual test with execution and description capabilities.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator for navigating through collections of tests or categories.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ITestController::ICategory
classes.description: Interface representing a test category with setup, teardown, and test registration functions.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes resources for the test controller or category.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Releases resources used by the test controller or category.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs a test with given parameters, returning the result as a string.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the test.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the test or category.

methods.name: Tests
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the tests in a category.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Retrieves a specific test by name within a category.

methods.name: Categories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all categories.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Retrieves a specific category by name.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Adds a test to the category.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a test from the category.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is at a valid position.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Returns the current test pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the current category pointed to by the iterator.
